reserves.name: M0 M locked on Ethereum against the Noble representation

reserveReview.reviewer: Pharos reserve research (ODR-C5 fixed-height M principal verification)

sources.label: Noble public REST: dollar-module stats, index, and uusdn bank supply at height 58284069 (2026-09-01T10:27:17Z)

reserveReview.rationale: USDN is the Noble representation of M0's M, not an independently issued Noble liability. Noble's architecture documentation states that because the Noble Dollar is collateralized by $M, issuance can only happen by locking $M as collateral on Ethereum through M0's Portal, with both principal and accrued yield bridged to Noble over Wormhole NTT; the exit is the reverse bridge back into $M. Verified directly on chain at Noble height 58284069 (2026-09-01T10:27:17Z): the dollar module reports total_principal 1,835,201.076317 $M and an M index of 1.093272766999, giving a present value of 2,006,375.358705, against a uusdn bank supply of 2,006,375.358704 - a 1:1 match to the last micro-unit, so every circulating USDN is covered by locked $M principal and nothing else. A USDN holder's claim therefore runs against M0's M, and M0's own Treasury and cash collateral is reviewed on the tracked m-m0 parent rather than duplicated here as a second, parallel claim.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Noble USDN architecture and M0 portal documentation plus fixed-height Noble dollar-module principal, index, and uusdn supply reads
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No direct reserve asset remains unidentified: the whole claim is the tracked m-m0 parent, whose own collateral composition is reviewed on that entry.
